source_note: The operating frame and alignment criteria are now anchored to direct source language from the private MeOS Saturn Return Companion supplied by the user on 2026-09-05. Domain bucket labels remain reconstructed classifications unless a later source confirms verbatim historical labels. Verbatim wording re-verified 2026-09-06 against saved copies of all eight MeOS sections and the "Perceptive Architect" decision reference: the freedom dimension was corrected from a paraphrase, and the morning-compass statement is recorded as one observed variant rather than a canonical line.
north_star: Build the life that can carry who you are.
chapter_frame: This chapter is asking for adult authorship, not perfection. Choose what you will build, lead, sustain—and no longer carry.

morning_compass.title: Remember who you are.
morning_compass.statement: I can act before certainty is perfect and build slowly enough to carry consequence.
morning_compass.statement_note: The companion rotates this line. The statement above was captured 2026-09-05; a variant observed 2026-09-06 reads "My sensitivity is information. My structure turns that information into impact." Neither is established as canonical.

daily_rule.title: One durable commitment.
daily_rule.prompt: What is the one action that creates lasting value today?

quick_return.title: Clarity before volume.
quick_return.rule: One recognized insight · one clean boundary · one durable action · a pace worth repeating.

alignment_dimensions.name: Recognition
alignment_dimensions.question: Will my judgment be genuinely valued here?

alignment_dimensions.name: Authority
alignment_dimensions.question: Does my responsibility match my influence and resources?

alignment_dimensions.name: Foundation
alignment_dimensions.question: Will this create durable value beyond urgency or appearance?

alignment_dimensions.name: Body
alignment_dimensions.question: Can my body sustain this pace for six months?

alignment_dimensions.name: Reciprocity
alignment_dimensions.question: Are honesty, effort, and care moving both ways?

alignment_dimensions.name: Freedom
alignment_dimensions.question: Does the structure preserve enough autonomy, movement, and room to experiment?

decision_sentence: I choose the option where my insight is recognized, my role is clear, reciprocity is visible, my body can sustain the pace, and the structure creates durable freedom.
next_personal_year_prompt: Review what deserves another year of your life.

goals.name: Build & Own
goals.description: Build durable products, intellectual property, ownership, and leverage rather than optimizing only for income or activity.
success_signals: first paid client or revenue evidence

goals.name: Visible Leadership
goals.description: Become known for one valuable point of view and capability by making the thinking, evidence, and work legible in public.
success_signals: clear association with a valuable capability

goals.name: Relationship Equity
goals.description: Build with the right people, strengthen collaboration, and create relationships that compound beyond a single transaction.

goals.name: Modeling & Presence
goals.description: Re-establish modeling as an active creative and professional practice with current work, visibility, and collaboration.

goals.name: Music & Creative Return
goals.description: Keep writing, recording, releasing, and returning to singing and performance as a real creative practice.

goals.name: Writing & Art
goals.description: Make essays, poetry, visual work, and field notes visible as part of the broader creative practice.

goals.name: Learning & Capability
goals.description: Deepen agentic, technical, creative, and operating capability while turning learning into reusable systems and teaching.
success_signals: learning applied to a live build
